C1551.title: Analysis of the Poly Network Cross-Chain Bridge Heist
C1551.summary: On August 10, 2021, Poly Network cross-chain bridge was attacked and more than 610 million US dollars in assets were stolen; the attacker later returned all tokens and user assets were restored. Industry analysis treats the incident as a typical cross-chain bridge security vulnerability case and it triggered broad discussion of bridge security. Attribution to OKLink Research Institute experts should be supported with the corresponding source if retained.
